title: End membership ends in the app whatever the provider answers
assertion: Both End membership routes (the console's and an organization's Settings) end the membership and every session of the account, move the account's mark and write `membership_ended` in one transaction, and the web asks the provider for nothing, inside it or after it: no file under apps/web holds a call to, a method for or a mention of the provider's sign-out, held by a scan; the database queues one `provider_sign_out` row on that event, tied to it and to the request, carrying IDs only, and the platform job sends it (JOB-06 to JOB-08); a refused End membership queues nothing, and one whose COMMIT the server refuses leaves no row, no audit event, the membership standing and the session active; a reset's row is queued the same way, one for a retried try, and a reset whose transaction fails twice, a refused code and an unknown outcome with no account queue none; a code step and a key-registration step begun before End membership are refused after it as after a reset (SGN-17's refusals); `ProviderSignOutNotDelivered` alarms on the platform log group for the job's line, and the web's two alarms for a failed sign-out are gone
noFileReason: Synthetic personas have a membership ended through both routes with a provider twin whose sign-out fails, and steps begun before it are answered after; no file.
